cursor.description: filters.pagination.next_cursor; repeat all other arguments unchanged.

measure.description: current or original registered contract value, or unique contract count.

agency.description: Exact case-sensitive label from filters.discovery.agency.accepted_labels; omit agency to discover the set.

fiscal_year.description: NYC registration fiscal year, July 1 of the preceding year through June 30, derived from registration date.

identifier_path.description: JSON Pointer to the identifier array named by a continuation.

identifier_offset.description: Offset for identifier arrays only; use the returned continuation with unchanged result filters.

identifier_limit.description: Maximum identifiers per array; counts and replay continuations accompany sampled arrays.
